audience: roofing and home service contractors who track customers, jobs and invoices in JobNimbus

useCases.title: List jobs by status
useCases.text: The AI lists jobs, for example those in the Approved or Lead status, or those linked to one contact. It reads name, address, sales rep and status for each job.

useCases.title: Check invoices and estimates with their totals
useCases.text: The AI lists invoices with total, amount paid, amount due and due date, and estimates with status, total and e-sign state. You see what is still owed.

useCases.title: Check open tasks, or create and complete a task
useCases.text: The AI lists open tasks and appointments, for all records or one contact or job. It can create a task or mark one complete.

useCases.title: Add a note to a job or contact
useCases.text: The AI reads the activity feed of a contact or job and adds a new note to it, for example that materials arrive on Thursday.

useCases.title: Create a job or update its details
useCases.text: The AI creates a job linked to a homeowner contact, or changes a job's status, address, sales rep or dates. It checks the valid workflow and status names first.

useCases.title: Look up, add or update a contact
useCases.text: The AI searches contacts and reads one with phones, email, address and status. It can create a contact or change fields, including its workflow status.
